scope: Actual fixed-north-core plus lower-side native1254 crop at stored alpha

findings.detail: The removed intermediate ledge improves the large geometric shape, but wood grain/brightness/shadow still stop at the fixed north core border at target y640. The line is clearly visible across the face and especially in the shadow at target x690..1050.
The saved alpha transitions to the existing bottom content with a visible horizontal dark/ghost stripe, clearest in the left and right vertical wooden supports and backboard.

requiredFollowup: A further builtin native repair must match both immutable upper boundary and original lower/support boundary. Do not use RGB correction, modify upper neighbor, or publish this trial as passed.
